mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate level directly influences equity valuation models.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20d return when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest 25% of historical values is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, prompting Federal Reserve rate cut expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts above 1650 thousand and retail sales above 530000 million dollars signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when both HOUST > 1650 and RSAFS > 530000, or the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a negative Rank IC with 20d returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 110), a decline in industrial production below 105 signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 110 and INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns is positive in the late-cycle expansion regime over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1650 thousand signal strong housing market activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate sectoral momentum and consumer confidence effects.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in >60% of instances when HOUST > 1650, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5d returns is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a higher federal funds rate level compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is positive in the monetary tightening cycle regime over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate above 3.8% and payroll employment decline below 152000 thousand signal severe labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through recession expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 3.8 and PAYEMS < 152000, or the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has a positive Rank IC with 60d returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as manufacturing weakness triggers immediate market risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d returns is positive over any 2-year rolling window.
